objective: Classify global palette maps preserving two non-tight distance classes, prove the exact three-map per-vertex CSP formulation with terminal completion, and freeze the minimum local CSP obstruction without claiming C1 or root closure.

atomic_claims.text: Every homomorphism from any of the three Cayley graphs with source distances {7,8,9}, {7,8,10}, or {7,9,10} into K_{20/7} is a translation or reflection.
No such dihedral map, even followed by arbitrary Q and R colors compatible with the frozen terminal interface, yields an O extension for either C1 value.
Choosing T8, T9, or T10 independently at each actual exterior vertex is exactly a three-state binary CSP retaining every edge and chord; every terminal option state admits explicit Q/R/O completion.
Tree messages are lossless and arc-domain deletion terminates on arbitrary graphs; a nonempty cyclic fixed point remains only a necessary condition outside forests.
The colored path 19-8-0 is a minimum connected obstruction to independent use of the three V14 maps; it refutes only that menu, not graph colorability or the root.

assumptions: The frozen V10-V14 terminal interface and actual valid exterior coloring; all chords, repeated endpoint identities, values, and rotations are retained.
The whole-palette rigidity claim concerns maps defined on all twenty colors and source graphs containing exactly the declared distance classes.
The per-vertex CSP claim is limited to the fixed menu {T8,T9,T10}; failure does not imply failure of arbitrary recoloring.
risks: The finite normalized permutation classification remains in the candidate generator trust domain and has no trusted verifier receipt.
The minimum three-vertex CSP obstruction need not occur in a genuine minimum root obstruction and is not a root counterexample.
No cyclic CSP completeness, uniformly liftable absorption, whole C1 closure, or C2-C4 advance is claimed.
No Lean, SMT, EvidenceLink, Result, or Solution admission occurred.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: A class-oblivious whole-palette map preserving class 7 and any two of 8,9,10 must be dihedral and cannot complete the frozen C1 interface. Reject only this global-map extension of V14.
